## Summary

Describe the problem and the focused change that solves it.

## User-visible and compatibility impact

Describe changes to behavior, syntax, APIs, configuration, performance, memory use, or platform support. Write `None` when there is no user-visible or compatibility impact.

## Validation

List the exact commands and manual checks you ran, including results.

## Checklist

- [ ] I kept this pull request focused on one logical change.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for changed behavior.
- [ ] Relevant Cargo build, check, and test commands complete with zero compiler warnings.
- [ ] I ran `cargo fmt --all -- --check`.
- [ ] I updated English public text, examples, and documentation where applicable.
- [ ] I documented any public API or configuration change and kept stable identifiers in English.
- [ ] I did not add credentials, private data, generated binaries, or unrelated files.
- [ ] I reviewed dependency and license impact for any dependency change.
